reviews.title: On going issue with iPad not addressed after a long time
reviews.text:
I loved this app.  But for a long while now there is an issue on the iPad where it scrolls sporadically when activating the auto sxceoll.  Which is the main reason I purchased the subscription to this app.  And it is the thing that does not work.  And I just got hit with the renewal cost.  Kinda ironic.  I am going to stick with it for a bit longer.  But if this is not addressed, I am going to drop it.  Sorry to say that, but there are other apps that have tab features.

Follow up.  The app has not gotten an update in a long time.  I reported an issue with the app not keeping its place when going to scrolling mode and it jumps randomly.  Athena same taking happens when bookmarking.  Now a new problem started occurring where bookmarks are not synched across devices, and sometimes show 2 bookmarks for Athena same color.  This started happening in the last couple of os updates.  I REALLY hate to say this, I love the app, but the developer is not paying attention to it.  I don’t think I will be renewing. My subscription.
